_record: APPEND-ONLY RECORD of REAL user turns from Olumi staging sessions, recovered from debug exports on 17 Sep 2026. These are sentences users actually typed. Add to it; never edit it.
_why: CLAUDE.md trap 22: a corpus drawn from the author's head cannot see the class the author did not imagine, and a 25/25 mutant kit will certify it. Routing predicates over natural language must be measured against real traffic. This corpus already refuted one hypothesis before a line was written: 'a question is not an edit instruction' would have broken ~25 legitimate polite edit requests.
